findings.title: Reject impossible stage and quantity combinations
findings.originalText: When a positive-size inspection reports `ReadyFromCache`, this constructor accepts it even though the inspection still requires network transfer; conversely, after all bytes/files are complete it accepts `ConsentRequired` because that check uses the inspection's initial `RequiresNetwork` rather than the derived remaining quantities. These combinations contradict the download state machine and can make the bootstrap skip required downloading or ask for mobile consent when no transfer remains. Constrain `ReadyFromCache` to zero-work inspections and `ConsentRequired` to snapshots with positive remaining work.
